proofread.question: Do you want to use the proofreading tool?
proofread.details: LanguageTool checks the spelling, grammar, punctuation and style of this chapter; unsaved changes are saved first. The issues are marked in the chapter's text: pick a suggestion and apply it with ✓, or dismiss it with ✗. Meanwhile you can keep writing and use the other tools. The proofreading is saved with the chapter, so you can come back to it later.
